summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for circuit breaker with undervoltage release, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: This combined breaker form marks a current protective device with a documented loss-of-voltage operating function. The control-voltage path must be established from the actual equipment diagram because it can differ from the feeder voltage being interrupted.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Follow the release supply independently of the main feeder.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A breaker release and a voltage-measuring relay are different devices even when both contribute to the same trip sequence.
